headline: Apollo Tyres: Onkar Kanwar Files SEBI Reg. 31(4) Disclosure of Substantial Share Acquisition
sum: Onkar Kanwar submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Apollo Tyres Limited. The filing triggers mandatory regulatory scrutiny under takeover protocols and may presage a formal open offer depending on the aggregate shareholding position.
detail: Onkar Kanwar filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Apollo Tyres Limited as of 30 June 2026. Under SEBI's Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of acquisition of shares leading to or likely to lead to a change in control or material modification of shareholding. The filing signals either a threshold crossing (typically 25% of equity capital) or acquisition of voting rights that triggers mandatory disclosure and potential open offer obligations. Apollo Tyres, listed on both NSE and BSE, is a major Indian tyre manufacturer; Onkar Kanwar is the founder and promoter of the company.
